meta.name: Ogilvy
meta.tagline: We inspire brands and people to impact the world.

archetype.rationale: A3, operator-selected 2026-08-25. Category-authority posture — 'Network of the Year' award ticker, 80+ country scale, the David Ogilvy canon as institutional doctrine — with Creator secondary keeping the work itself the hero (the homepage is a gallery of exhibits, not a services list). Note: no archetype is stated in any Ogilvy-published material; this is an operator reading of public evidence, not a brand-owner declaration.

identity.positioning: We design the brand; we turn the brand into an experience; and we communicate the brand’s story.

fonts.note: Ogilvy Serif + Ogilvy Sans are PROPRIETARY custom typefaces (rightsStatus: restricted) — not redistributable and no OFL substitute selected, so no embedFamily. Server-side renders and web fall back to the documented stacks (Georgia / Helvetica Neue).

label.note: L1 'ticker caps' — the eyebrow/kicker role. Derived from the site's oversized uppercase marquee rows scaled to eyebrow size. Prevents the org-wide monospace eyebrow default.

wordmark.note: Display/wordmark role — the high-contrast Didone serif of the logotype. Never set body copy in this role.

logo.notes: Primary SVG uses currentColor — renders ink on light, set color for dark; logo-white.* for dark/photo backgrounds; logo-red.svg for the brand's own on-white lockup (evidenced: ogilvy.com nav renders the wordmark in Ogilvy Red on white). No clean vector mark on the source site; favicon set reused from ogilvy.com.

principles: Single-accent discipline: the Ogilvy Red is the sole non-neutral; pink is a tint of it, never a second hue.
Red is a canvas, not only an accent — covers and heroes are full-bleed red fields.
Editorial serif/sans pairing carries hierarchy — restraint over ornament.
The work is exhibited, not decorated: content sits in a strict gallery grid.
Depth comes from occlusion and surface change, never from shadow.

density.note: Generous gutters and whitespace around the gallery grid and statement type (ogilvy.com hero + gallery sections, 2026-08-25 capture).

contrast.note: Ink on white / white on red; no mid-tone surfaces in the system.

symmetry.note: Symmetric modular grids and centred wordmark, with asymmetric editorial moments (type/image overlap).

geometry.note: Rectangles and circles only; the sole border-radius measured on ogilvy.com is 50% (dots/toggles).

typeExpression.note: Magazine anatomy — Didone display serif against a neutral grotesque; roles are fluid between the two.

imageTreatment.note: PH1 — vivid untreated campaign photography presented as white-framed exhibits; no brand filter applied.

motifProminence.note: The red field plus the gallery grid ARE the composition; the Big O is a structural crop/frame device, not decoration.

colorRhythm.note: Monochrome base with one red; the pink tint extends the red rather than adding a hue.

ornament.note: No decorative flourishes; hairline rules and the dot-rule are the only marks.

energy.note: MO2 — continuous marquee bands at section moments and oversized type events; still between those beats. Expressive at the beat, never busy.

depth.note: E1 — type/image overlap everywhere, zero shadow depth. Layering is by occlusion, not elevation.

materiality.note: Flat print-like surfaces throughout; poster and press heritage. No gloss, grain, glass or metal anywhere in the system.

continuity.note: Reveals sequence per section; ticker bands run continuously within their own band only.

signatureElements: Ogilvy Red (#EB3F43) as a full-bleed canvas, not only an accent
The Big O — the wordmark's own O glyph oversized and cropped at the edge as a frame/crop device
The four-column gallery grid, carried on both red and white canvases
Uppercase ticker bands as type-as-texture and as the brand's signature motion
Proprietary Ogilvy Serif + Ogilvy Sans type pairing (display serif, text sans)
antiPatterns: Introducing a second brand hue — the system is mono plus one red (pink is a tint of that red).
Shipping the proprietary fonts (restricted) — use the fallback stack.
Drop shadows or any elevation effect — depth is by occlusion only.
Setting an eyebrow in monospace — the label role is uppercase Ogilvy Sans with wide tracking.
Applying a brand filter, duotone or tint to campaign photography — imagery runs vivid and untreated.
Decorative use of the Big O at small scale — it is a structural crop device, minimum 40% of the surface's short edge.
Scraping or reusing ogilvy.com campaign imagery — it is client IP.

2026-08-25 brand-smell review gate. Operator selections: S2 semantic, L1 label, B1 backgrounds, G1 gradients, GR1 grid, M1 motifs, P1 patterns, I2 iconography, PH1 photo, E1 elevation, MO2 motion, SM2 signatureMotion, T1 imagery theme, A3 archetype; axes as-proposed.

expression.signatureMotion: An uppercase band glides continuously while everything else settles over it — the red field itself never moves.

evidence.source: _build/reviews/evidence/ogilvy-home-{viewport,mid,lower}.png (2026-08-25) — full-bleed #EB3F43 hero, white gallery sections, #FBCECE panels. Operator-selected B1 on OGILVY-Enhancement-Board.html.

spec.name: Red Gallery (4-surface)
spec.note: Content stays on gallery-white; red is reserved for covers, heroes and section openers so the field keeps its impact.

evidence.source: _build/reviews/evidence/ogilvy-home-mid.png — vertical red→pink→white wash at the section transition. Operator-selected G1.

spec.name: Section wash only
spec.note: The ONLY gradient in the system. Every other surface is a flat field — a gradient on a content page is off-grammar.

evidence.source: _build/reviews/evidence/ogilvy-home-{viewport,lower}.png — strict 4-column thumbnail grid with equal gutters on both red and white canvases. Operator-selected GR1.

spec.name: Gallery modular
spec.note: Content is exhibited: equal cells, equal gutters, generous outer margin. Spans of 2 or 4 cells are permitted; ragged or masonry layouts are not.

evidence.source: _build/reviews/evidence/ogilvy-home-viewport.png — the giant serif wordmark overlapping the gallery grid. Glyph extracted from the canonical logos/logo.svg by _build/reviews/build-motifs.py (not redrawn). Operator-selected M1.

spec.name: The Big O

marks.name: big-o
marks.desc: The wordmark's own O glyph, oversized and cropped at the surface edge — frame, crop mask and divider ornament.

marks.name: rule-dot
marks.desc: Dot-plus-hairline mark used as bullet, leader line and chart annotation; also precedes nothing by default (the L1 eyebrow is type-only).

usageCaps.bigOMinScale: 40% of the surface's short edge — below that it reads as a letter, not a device

spec.note: Operator selected M1 only. The ticker device (board M3) was deliberately NOT taken as a static motif — it lives in the motion dimension instead, so static surfaces carry the Big O + ghost grid and moving surfaces carry the band. See visual_grammar.motion.spec.staticCounterpart.

evidence.source: Derived from the GR1 gallery grid as a surface texture. Operator-selected P1.

spec.name: Ghost grid
spec.construction: The 4-column gallery grid drawn as 1px outlines only, at low opacity, echoing the structural grid as background texture.
spec.intendedScale: background-size: 100% auto — four columns across the full surface. Never a fine repeat: at small tile sizes it reads as graph paper, not as the brand's grid.
spec.note: Reduced from the board's 0.35 to 0.22 on red after full-bleed QA (0.35 read as structure rather than texture at tile density).

evidence.source: Derived from the site's hairline rules and 50%-only radii. Operator-selected I2.

spec.corner: square joins; circles only where a radius is needed
spec.color: #231F20 default; #EB3F43 ONLY to mark the active or emphasised icon, never decoratively
spec.note: Quieter than the alternative dot-accented set — red in iconography is a state, not a style.

evidence.source: _build/reviews/evidence/ogilvy-home-lower.png — vivid full-colour campaign work presented as framed exhibits. Operator-selected PH1.

spec.name: Campaign vivid
spec.treatment: none — full colour, high vibrancy, no brand filter, duotone or tint
spec.presentation: white-framed exhibit cells on the red canvas; edge-to-edge cells on white
spec.overlayTextPolicy: Do not set text over vivid imagery. Text lives on the red, pink, white or ink surface adjacent to the image.
spec.sourcing: Generated or licensed ONLY. ogilvy.com campaign photography is client IP and is never scraped or reused.
spec.note: The absence of a treatment IS the treatment — the work is shown as the client made it.

evidence.source: No box-shadow measured anywhere on ogilvy.com (2026-08-25 computed-style sweep). Operator-selected E1.

spec.name: Flat + hairline
spec.borders: 1px hairline, #E2DEDF on white, rgba(255,255,255,0.35) on red
spec.depthMechanism: surface colour change and occlusion (type/image overlap) — never a shadow
spec.note: Print-faithful. A drop shadow anywhere in an Ogilvy deliverable is off-grammar.

evidence.source: _build/reviews/evidence/ogilvy-home-mid.png — continuous 'NETWORK OF THE YEAR' marquee band plus scroll-driven settle reveals. Operator-selected MO2 + SM2.

spec.name: Ticker energy

primitives.name: ticker-band
primitives.desc: Uppercase type band translating continuously at constant velocity within its own band; never eases, never stops.

primitives.name: settle-reveal
primitives.desc: Content rises ~14px and fades in, then rests. Surfaces themselves never move.

spec.continuity: section-sequence — a section's reveals sequence on entry; the ticker runs continuously and independently.
spec.staticCounterpart: On static surfaces (render_pdf, render_pptx, render_deck stills) the ticker band renders as a static uppercase type-as-texture row at the same position — this is the one place the board's M3 device appears without being a selected motif. The Big O and ghost grid carry the static surfaces.
spec.note: Feeds render_motion and render_video directly; render_deck transitions use settle-reveal only.
